collection: Six held historical website portrait candidates
scope: Approved for website presentation only. These assets do not activate, build in, preinstall, redistribute, or admit any persona pack to an Official Catalog.

generation.seed_availability: No seed was provided by the generation response.
generation.policy: Text-to-image generation only; no photograph, archive scan, logo, signature, painting, or other source image was supplied. Prompts explicitly prohibited copying specific images and prohibited text, signatures, watermarks, logos, and authenticity claims.

conversion.operation: Original 768x1024 PNG converted to same-dimension WebP using libwebp, quality 82, compression level 6, picture preset. CSS applies crop, color wash, scanlines, and keyline nondestructively.
conversion.public_asset_policy: Only final candidate WebPs are stored under site/. Working PNGs and prompts remain in this review directory outside the deployable static site.
